transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been feeling really shut down. The part of me that used to want to connect with people or enjoy things just feels… quiet. I still go through my responsibilities, but I don’t really feel much from my work, yoga, going to galleries, even journaling. It’s like I’m mostly just moving through obligations.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, like yoga, galleries, or journaling?

Yes. That’s actually what finally made me come in. I used to feel pulled toward people, and I’d get something out of my work, yoga, galleries, journaling… but lately that part of me feels very quiet. I still do some of those things because they’re part of my routine, but it feels more like I’m just getting through obligations than enjoying them.
Have you been feeling down or having low energy lately?

Yes, more low energy than exactly “sad,” I think. I feel kind of shut down. The part of me that used to want to reach out to people or get something from work, yoga, galleries, journaling… it’s just gone quiet. I’m still doing what I need to do, but mostly it feels like I’m moving through obligations.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your energy levels or have you been feeling fatigued, even after resting?

Yes, I think so. I still get things done, but it takes more effort, and resting doesn’t really bring back that feeling of wanting to do things. It’s like the part of me that used to reach for people or enjoy work, yoga, galleries, journaling… it’s just gone very quiet. Mostly I’m just moving through obligations.
Have you been feeling this way for at least two weeks straight, or has it come and gone in shorter periods?

It’s been longer than two weeks. I’d say this whole change in how I’m thinking, working, and connecting with people has been going on for about eight months now—since we took my older relative into our apartment.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt little interest or pleasure in doing things nearly every day?

Yes. Most days, almost every day, I’d say. It’s not that I’m crying all the time, it’s more that I don’t really feel pulled toward anything. Work, yoga, galleries, even journaling… things I used to get something from just feel flat, like I’m only doing what I have to do.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining a noticeable amount without trying?
Not that I’ve really noticed. My clothes fit about the same, and I haven’t been trying to lose or gain weight. So I don’t think there’s been a significant change.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or have been blaming yourself for things more than usual?
I don’t think so, not more than usual. I can get frustrated with myself, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling worthless or blaming myself all the time.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or have others commented that you seem slowed down? Or on the flip side, have you felt restless or been unable to sit still lately?

I haven’t really noticed that, no. I don’t think I’ve been moving especially slowly, and I don’t think anyone’s commented on it. I also wouldn’t say I’ve been unable to sit still—nothing like that stands out.
Have you had any previous episodes like this, where you felt shut down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time, before this current period started?

I’m not sure I’d call it separate “episodes” before this. What brought me in is more that lately the part of me that used to reach out to people and enjoy things—my work, yoga, going to galleries, even journaling—has just gotten very quiet. I’m mostly just getting through what I have to do.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this current one where you felt this way—like you’ve lost interest in things and feel shut down—for more than two weeks in a row?

Not really before this, no. This feels more like what finally made me come in now—the part of me that used to reach out to people or enjoy my work, yoga, galleries, even journaling has just gotten very quiet. I’m still doing obligations, mostly, but I don’t feel that pull toward things the way I used to.
Have you had any days in the past two weeks where you felt down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know that I’d say sad most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve had some low moments, but I haven’t really been tracking it that way.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or have you been blaming yourself for things more than usual during this time?
Not really. I mean, I have moments where I wonder why I can’t just feel more like myself, but I wouldn’t say I’m blaming myself a lot or feeling worthless. It’s more confusion than guilt, I guess.
During this time, have you felt like you're not good enough or blamed yourself for things more than usual?
I don’t think so. I’ve had some frustration with myself, like wondering why I can’t snap out of this, but I wouldn’t say I feel not good enough or that I’m blaming myself more than usual.
Have you had any days during this eight-month period where you felt so down or hopeless that it was noticeably worse than just feeling shut down or uninterested?
I’m not sure I’d describe it as hopeless, no. There were days I felt pretty flat or checked out, but I don’t remember a clear stretch where I felt really down in a noticeably different way.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this current one where you felt like you had completely lost interest in things and felt shut down for more than two weeks in a row?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had stressful times before, but I can’t remember another period where I felt this shut down or uninterested for more than a couple weeks straight.
